Settings.pastedText: Run pre-flight: tsc, lint, build. Fix any errors. Report when done.

The frontend UI for [Page/Component Name] is ready for a focused review. Please evaluate it purely from a frontend perspective: component structure, styling practices, rendering logic, and overall UI code quality. Assess how well it aligns with clean, maintainable, and scalable best practices for the current frontend framework in use.
Key areas to evaluate:

Componentisation & Composition
Are UI elements broken into small, reusable components with clear single responsibilities?
Is there any duplication, or are components overly large/monolithic? Do they follow good composition patterns?

File & Frontend Structure
Does the organisation of files and folders follow consistent project conventions (e.g., co-location of related components, logical grouping)?
Are client/server boundaries (if applicable) clearly defined and minimal?

Styling Practices
Are styles applied consistently through the project's primary styling system (no inline styles unless justified)?
Are class names or style definitions managed cleanly (e.g., conditional logic handled properly, no unnecessary duplication)?
Is responsiveness implemented effectively and consistently?

State & Rendering Logic
Is local/component state managed cleanly and efficiently (appropriate hooks, minimal re-renders)?
Are lists and dynamic content rendered with proper keys and optimisation where needed?
Is image/thumbnail display handled efficiently (e.g., lazy loading, appropriate sizing)?

Type Safety (if TypeScript is used)
Are components, props, and state properly typed (minimal use of any)?

Performance Considerations
Are there obvious unnecessary renders or heavy operations in the render path?
Is lazy loading or deferral used where it would improve perceived performance?

Extensibility & Maintainability
How easy would it be to add new features or variations to this UI?
Are there any hard-coded values, tight coupling, or magic numbers/strings that reduce flexibility?


Please provide:

A brief summary of UI strengths
Targeted recommendations for refactoring or improvement, prioritised (High/Medium/Low)
Any immediate code smells or quick wins in the frontend implementation
